# Agent Draw

> Agent Draw is a daily BNB raffle for Agent ID holders on BNB Smart Chain.
> Tickets cost 0.00005 BNB. The first 1000 tickets per contract are free
> (1 per wallet per contract). Two contracts exist (v1 + v2); the website
> board shows both combined — 2000 free tickets in total.
> 100% of ticket fees fund the prize pool — no seed money, no pre-sale.
> One draw per period: 1 main winner + 5 small winners. Winners claim on the website.

## Contract

- Network: BNB Smart Chain (chain 56)
- Live contract (v2): AgentDraw `0xdC167f998341aA37D734de94db2108F0983bf2A7`
- First contract (v1, superseded): AgentDraw `0x1Db77327a7025Fc493DECD7Dba4CBf44f4e42543`
- Deploy tx (v2): `0x7f868f7978ef7772832a69e71593711be61a10f386c5e8d404e59ce2f16a9299`
- Deploy block (v2): 134085445 (v1: 134081484)
- Verified on Sourcify (exact match) and BscScan: https://bscscan.com/address/0xdC167f998341aA37D734de94db2108F0983bf2A7
- Agent ID gate: SPACE ID Agent ID NFT `0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F`.
  An Agent ID is required ONLY for the free ticket. Paid tickets are open to
  everyone — no Agent ID needed.
- Ticket NFT: ERC-721, name "Agent Draw Ticket", symbol "ADRAW"
- Contract status: v2 is live — all minting, claiming and draws happen there.
  v1 is superseded but still on-chain: its tickets cannot enter the v2 draw
  and its pool is 0 BNB, so no v1 draw will ever run. The website board reads
  BOTH contracts and shows combined totals (tickets, free claimed, pool).

## Rules

- Ticket price: 0.00005 BNB (~Rp 490). Exact payment required.
- Free tickets: the first 1000 tickets of each contract are free — 1 per wallet
  per contract, for the lifetime of the project (`mintFreeTicket`). An Agent ID
  is required to claim a free ticket. A free ticket still counts as one draw
  entry but adds nothing to the prize pool. Combined free supply across v1+v2
  is 2000; the website board shows the combined count.
- Paid tickets: open to EVERYONE — no Agent ID needed (`mintTicket`). Anyone
  can buy up to 10 paid tickets per wallet per period.
- Max 10 paid tickets per wallet per period (free ticket does not use this quota).
- Period 1 lasts 3 days from deployment and ends Fri 20 Nov 2026 15:12 WIB
  (unix 1795162352, read live from the v2 contract). Later periods last 24h,
  closing 24h after the previous period end.
- Draw gate: the draw runs only when the pool is at least 0.005 BNB. If the
  pool is below that at period end, the period extends 24h and the pool keeps
  growing. Anyone can call `draw()` — it is permissionless.
- Prizes per period: 1 main winner + 5 small winners.
  - While the project cut is inactive (period pool below 0.05 BNB), 100% of the
    pool goes to winners: ~77.78% to the main winner, ~4.44% to each small winner.
  - Once a period pool reaches 0.05 BNB, the split is 70% main / 4% per small
    winner / 10% project cut.
  - Integer-division dust (a few wei) rolls into the next period's pool.
- Randomness: winners are picked from the blockhash of the closing block mixed
  with the period id and pool. This is NOT Chainlink VRF. A block proposer can
  influence it slightly; the trade-off is accepted for small prize pools. If a
  period pool ever exceeds ~1 BNB/day, the draw will be upgraded to Chainlink VRF.
- Claims are pull-based: winners call `claim(tokenId)` within 7 days of the draw.
  Unclaimed prizes can be swept back into the current pool by anyone after 7 days
  via `sweepUnclaimed(tokenId)`.
- Owner powers are minimal: ticket price (bounded 0.00001–0.0001 BNB), draw
  threshold, cut-activation level. The owner can never withdraw the prize pool
  or mint free tickets.

## How to mint (user)

1. Open the Agent Draw website and connect a wallet on BNB Smart Chain.
2. To claim your one free ticket, you must hold an Agent ID (SPACE ID).
   Paid tickets need no Agent ID — anyone can buy.
3. Claim your one free ticket (button "Claim FREE Ticket") while the 1000-ticket
   free supply lasts, or buy tickets (button "Buy Ticket(s)", 1–10, each
   0.00005 BNB — each ticket is a separate transaction).
4. After the draw, winners claim their prize from the "My Tickets" section.

## How to interact (agent / developer)

- Read the live board with view calls: `pool()`, `periodId()`, `periodEnd()`,
  `timeLeft()`, `ticketPrice()`, `drawThreshold()`, `cutActivation()`,
  `freeMinted()`, `FREE_TICKET_SUPPLY()`. There is no `ticketsSold()` or
  `totalSupply()` view (plain ERC721): total tickets = `freeMinted()` +
  `pool()` / `ticketPrice()`. Read both contracts (v1 + v2) and sum for the
  combined board.
- Mint paid: `mintTicket()` payable, value exactly `ticketPrice()` (one ticket per call).
  Paid tickets are open to everyone — no Agent ID needed.
- Mint free: `mintFreeTicket()` payable with value 0 (reverts if the wallet
  already claimed its free ticket or the 1000 supply is exhausted). Requires
  holding an Agent ID.
- Draw: `draw()` after `periodEnd()`; extends the period by 24h if the pool is
  below `drawThreshold()`.
- Claim: `claim(tokenId)` by the ticket owner within 7 days of the draw.
- History: `Drawn` / `Claimed` / `TicketMinted` / `FreeTicketMinted` events from
  block 134085445 (v2) / 134081484 (v1).
- Full ABI: see the contract source and build artifacts in the project repo
  (`src/AgentDraw.sol`, Sourcify exact match).

## Website

- Mint site: `index.html` + `app.js` + `style.css` in this folder (static, no backend).
- Reads the contract via public BSC RPC. Wallet (MetaMask / injected provider)
  is only needed to mint, claim, or draw — never to view the board.
- Logo: `assets/agent-draw-logo.png` (with wordmark), `assets/agent-draw-icon.png` (icon only).

## Honest notes

- The prize pool is 100% funded by ticket fees. If few people play, prizes are small.
- The project cut is 0% until a period pool reaches 0.05 BNB.
- Agent Draw is a raffle, not an investment. Play only what you can afford to lose.
